description:
WS7 of _project/planning/ci-failure-reduction-plan.md. Soundness-path PRs correctly withhold auto-merge (CODEOWNERS mirror in _project/scripts/auto_merge_soundness_paths.py), but they then park silently and grow conflicts while parked - #1116 and #1142 sat for days awaiting the owner, and both needed conflict resolution during the wait. The withholding gate itself is correct and untouchable; the fix is making the queue drain observable.

Add a small scheduled job that lists open PRs which are (a) green on required checks, (b) auto-merge withheld or otherwise awaiting the owner, (c) idle > 24h - and emits one daily 'ready for your review: N PRs' signal (issue comment, notification, or morning-brief hook) plus an `awaiting-owner` label for at-a-glance triage. Target: median park time < 1 day, which also shrinks conflict churn on exactly the PRs that can least afford re-review.

anti_patterns.instead: One daily digest, silent when the queue is empty
anti_patterns.why: Notification fatigue defeats the signal within a week

anti_patterns.dont: Use pull_request_target or a long-lived PAT for the scheduled job
anti_patterns.instead: Scheduled (cron) trigger with default GITHUB_TOKEN, minimal permissions block
anti_patterns.why: Write-token automation on a public repo is an exfiltration risk (see dev-loop-step-6 anti-patterns)

preserves.behavior: No auto-merge, no auto-approve, no nudge that mutates PR state beyond the label
The soundness withholding gate itself is untouched - this item only observes and reports

verifications.description: Self-test passes offline against the bundled fixture (soundness PRs excluded, stranded PRs included)

work_units.evidence: soundness_drain_report.py: stdlib-only classifier (required-lane green via latest ci-required-result run, soundness via imported any_soundness_path, park-time>24h gate - mutation-independent per Opus review Required fix, pinned by anti-flap fixture case 9107); --json/--apply/--self-test; self-test 7 PRs/3 qualifying PASSED
work_units.notes: Ship a --self-test mode: runs against a bundled fixture PR set (no network/auth), asserts soundness-path PRs are excluded from the alert list and green+withheld+idle ones are included, exits 0/1. Also support --json for jq-able live output.
work_units.summary: Scheduled workflow/script: find green, owner-gated, idle>24h open PRs; apply awaiting-owner label; emit one daily summary

work_units.evidence: soundness-drain.yml: daily 05:00 UTC cron + dispatch; permissions contents:read/pull-requests:write/issues:write only; no pull_request_target; default GITHUB_TOKEN; digest = single marker-tagged issue, one-time empty-state patch on drain
work_units.summary: Wire the signal to the owner's preferred channel (issue, notification, or morning-brief) - confirm choice in PR

work_units.evidence: park_time_hours anchored on ci-required-result completed_at, emitted per PR in digest + --json for WS9 re-measure; documented in docs/operations/soundness-drain.md
